articles.title: Juice Uses Earth’s Gravity to Help It Reach Jupiter
articles.summary: Juice passed Earth on September 28, using its gravity to change course toward Jupiter and giving scientists a chance to test its instruments.

articles.title: Rare Rain Brings Colorful Wildflowers to Chile’s Atacama Desert
articles.summary: Rare rain linked to an exceptionally strong El Niño has brought colorful wildflowers to Chile’s Atacama Desert, creating its most extensive bloom since 1997.

articles.title: Scientists use “empty space” to strengthen superconductivity
articles.summary: A specially designed cavity strengthened superconductivity in NbSe2, raising its critical temperature by up to 5.4% in a six-layer device.
